name: Mizushima Kaoru
source:
She is a friend of Ami and a member of the swimming club.

She has been Ami's best friend and rival since before she went to her current school, and she regrets that Ami has stopped swimming.

She thinks that Ami's involvement in a strange club was caused by the main character, who often has a hard time dealing with her.

[From [url=http://rootnuko.jp/products/tenioha/character.html]official site[/url]]
